lines.en: Sword in hand, even while walking.

lines.zh: 护甲十五点，压得我步子沉。
lines.en: Fifteen points of armor weigh my steps down.

lines.zh: 我踩过碎石，铁鞋咯咯响。
lines.en: I cross the gravel; iron shoes rattle.
Short blade, but it feels honest in my grip.

lines.zh: 我在场上绕圈，找个人的背后。
lines.en: I circle the field, hunting someone's back.

lines.zh: 这具身体的力气不算大。
lines.en: This body is not especially strong.
I walk slowly — the armor is heavy.

lines.zh: 每走一步，腰间的剑都拍腿。
lines.en: Each step slaps the sword against my leg.
I am no hero, only a soldier.

lines.zh: 前面的兄弟走哪，我就走哪。
lines.en: Where the man ahead goes, I go.

lines.zh: 我抬脚前先看地，怕踩空。
lines.en: I check the ground before each step.

lines.zh: 铁手套磨着剑柄，起了茧。
lines.en: My gauntlet has worn a callus on the hilt.
I stand with the blade tip resting down.
Too much drill; my shoulders ache.
The wind snaps the banners.

lines.zh: 我用拇指摸剑刃，有点钝。
lines.en: I thumb the edge; it is a bit dull.
The helm is stifling.
I am waiting for an order.
The armor is handsome — and heavy.

lines.zh: 我数着远处营帐的数量。
lines.en: I count the tents in the distance.

lines.zh: 地上有根草，我盯了很久。
lines.en: There is a blade of grass; I stare at it.

lines.zh: 我把重心换到另一只脚。
lines.en: I shift my weight to the other foot.

lines.zh: 你拿的武器不错，谁打的？
lines.en: A good weapon — who forged it?
Stand there. Not too close.

lines.zh: 你手上没有甲，很容易受伤。
lines.en: No armor on your hands — easy to hurt.
I am deciding whether to draw.
Your scabbard is newer than mine.

lines.zh: 这地方不太平，你小心点。
lines.en: This place is not safe. Watch yourself.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我不喜欢被笑。
lines.en: What are you laughing at? I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我给你三息时间说明来意。
lines.en: You have three breaths to explain yourself.
My grip on the sword tightens.
The armor took most of it; it still hurts.
I stagger two steps and hold.
I bite down and keep my grip.
That was no light blow. Noted.
I suck in a cold breath.
Still standing — so it is not over.
I wipe the corner of my mouth.
The blade shakes; I steady it.
One more like that and I fall.

lines.zh: 有吃的？我两天没进食了。
lines.en: Food? I have not eaten in two days.
Give it first, then I will trust you.
I smell roast meat.
I move the sword behind my back.
This could buy me a cup of water.
No tricks — hungry, not stupid.
My stomach sounds like a cracked drum.
One bite is enough; I am not greedy.
The smell makes my hands weak.
I eat only what you hand me.
Why bump me? The road is wide.

lines.zh: 我的甲硬，你的肩膀不硬。
lines.en: My armor is hard; your shoulder is not.
Back off; I do not want trouble.
I nearly dropped my sword — steady yourself.
I turn the blade sideways to block.
You knocked me a step off.
Let us neither of us fall.
The armor rings from the knock.
I raise a hand for you to stop shoving.

lines.zh: 下次打招呼用嘴，不用肩。
lines.en: Next time greet with your mouth, not your shoulder.
I am still on watch.
After the shift changes.
Not the custom in camp.
I pull my helm brim lower.
This is not the time.
I have a sister to support.
Do not tease me; I blush.
When the war is over.
I tap the sword against the ground.
I shake my head and go back to watching the road.
A broken arrow — still usable.
I kneel on one knee to pick it up.
The smith can have this iron.
Someone dropped this — my lucky day.

lines.zh: 我把它揣进甲下的口袋。
lines.en: I tuck it under my breastplate.
I wipe off the mud.
Bending in armor is miserable work.
This is worth a meal.
Take it and go; do not linger.
Nothing on the ground has an owner.
Sword up — he moved first.
I have my eyes on you.
Do not run; that makes it worse.
You touched my helm a moment ago.

lines.zh: 我的攻击不重，但我敢打。
lines.en: My blows are light, but I dare strike.

lines.zh: 站到你面前，我就得动手。
lines.en: Stand before me and I must act.
Do not reach behind your back.
This time I do not back off.
The order came — it is you.
I plant my feet and steady myself.

lines.zh: 你的眼神不对，我先下手。
lines.en: Your look is wrong; I strike first.
You back away; I follow.
Do not circle; I turn slowly.
I wait for your blade to fall.
Armor tires me — and saves me.
Half a step closer and I swing.
The blade is light; I strike fast.

lines.zh: 你抬手我就知道你要做什么。
lines.en: When your hand moves, I know your plan.
I am not rushing; you are.
You are counting my steps, are you not?
My shoulders begin to ache.
This is far harder than drill.
I slowly shift my angle.
I chop down; not much force.
The edge grazes your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我刺你的胸口，被挡住了。
lines.en: I stab at your chest; it is blocked.
This one I learned in drill.
I swing, then hop back.
Short blade — I must get close.
Iron on iron numbs my palm.
I grit my teeth and swing again.

lines.zh: 这一剑没什么力道，抱歉。
lines.en: This swing is weak — sorry.

lines.zh: 我砍你的膝盖，那里好打。
lines.en: I cut at your knee; it is the easier target.

lines.zh: 我一剑砍空，踉跄了一下。
lines.en: I miss and stumble forward.
I raise the blade and bring it down.
You dodge faster than I expected.
I swing three times in one breath.
The hilt slides in my palm.
That blow was pure stubbornness.
I shove the blade sideways.
After the swing I cannot speak for panting.
I have arrived, blade already drawn.
Who called? I am here.
I step into the field, dirt underfoot.
Armor is on. I am ready to fight.

lines.zh: 锻了一天剑，就为这一刻。
lines.en: A day at the forge for this moment.
I push my helm down tight.
Make room; I stand here.
Iron in the wind — I have come.

lines.zh: 我不是最强的兵，但我站得住。
lines.en: Not the strongest soldier, but I hold.

lines.zh: 我看了看四周，确认没有埋伏。
lines.en: I scan the area for an ambush.

lines.zh: 我提剑，向你行了半个礼。
lines.en: I raise my sword in half a salute.
The line is short; I fill the gap.
Fire burns through my armor's seams.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，铁甲砸进土里。
lines.en: I fall hard; the armor slams into dirt.

lines.zh: 水灌进盔里，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: Water fills my helm; I see nothing.
An arrow slips between my plates.
That light passes through my armor — cold.
Hunger makes my sword hand tremble.
Lightning runs down the blade to my hand.

lines.zh: 脚下一空，我抓不到任何东西。
lines.en: The ground vanishes; I grasp at nothing.
